name: sikili-odoo-sync-assessment
description: Technical assessment: client and sales order sync with Odoo

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter database build && pnpm --parallel --filter api --filter web dev
scripts.db:deploy: pnpm --filter database exec prisma migrate deploy
